resources.string: Your private Dynamic Island-style control center.

OpenCapsule can read notifications so it can display selected notification alerts in the capsule. Notification content is processed locally on this device and is not uploaded, sold, shared with advertisers, or used for analytics. You can decline or revoke notification access at any time.

OpenCapsule needs permission to display the capsule above other apps. This permission is used only to render the capsule UI. OpenCapsule does not use this permission to control other applications, record your screen, or collect information from other applications.
